text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Winning 
Ticket...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, going out together is so much fun, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of Winning Ticket's screaming 
gaze were plushies lined up as crane game 
prizes.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm having lots of fun going out with you, 
Trainer, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If nobody adopts them, they'll be stuck in 
there forever, right...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! That's so sad~! We have to go save 
them~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems to have deeply empathized with 
the plushie. At this rate, Winning Ticket 
might never stop crying...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!! Do your best! I'm cheering for 
you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
